description: Publish an anonymised version of one of the user's CVs — no name or contact details — on a public page for recruiters, who can ask to reveal the candidate. PRO. This publishes a public page: only on the user's explicit request. Returns {stealthId, pseudoId, url} — keep stealthId to take it down later.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: create_takemeup_stealth_cv
title: Publish a stealth (anonymized) CV (PRO)
